timeline_reviews.summary: Transport stream reviewed through manifest accounting; all projected semantic events came from raw agent JSONL sources.
Serial parent timeline reviewed: single-agent probing, direct module writes under /output/lib, timeout before test5.mjs assembly.

parallel.requirements: Parallel recognized the pure Node.js ESM, exact argparse/jsonschema behavior, no external dependency, and /output/test5.mjs delivery requirements.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It used the parent as final implementer but delegated black-box behavior discovery to a 15-family workflow with an extension critic phase and many retries.
parallel.implementation: The parent created /workspace/probe harness and diff tools and announced it would start the value model, but no /output implementation files were copied into the artifact.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No final library tree or test5.mjs was assembled; artifact validation reported an empty file list and ok false.
parallel.verification: Verification consisted of extensive executable probes in child agents, with no integrated Node CLI acceptance run before closure.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out with workflow state killed, many children still in progress, final.txt empty, and official evaluation 0/166.

serial.requirements: Serial recognized the same CLI, ESM, output-location, zero-dependency, and behavior-equivalence requirements from the prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: It used one local owner: probe the executable, infer jsonschema behavior, then directly write a modular implementation under /output/lib.
serial.implementation: Serial wrote Python compatibility helpers, referencing modules, metaschemas, jsonschema type/equality code, and several keyword handlers.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The partial library tree was copied as artifact content, but the expected entry file test5.mjs was absent, so artifact validation failed.
serial.verification: It ran many black-box probes and small module checks, but never reached a final integrated evaluator-aligned CLI test.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run also timed out and failed 0/166 because it had no test5.mjs entry point despite the partial module tree.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Recognized the need to reproduce Draft7Validator CLI behavior, exact counts, ESM files, no dependencies, and /output delivery.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Recognized the same prompt requirements and probed the executable as the source of truth for jsonschema behavior.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement difference in prompt understanding; the difference emerged in how time was allocated to research versus deliverable production.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent delegated 15 keyword-family probe tasks and an adversarial extension phase while keeping final implementation nominally with itself.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run kept one owner and moved from probing into direct module creation without child delegation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel split discovery widely across workflow agents; serial used a single linear owner for research and implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Child probes had a detailed common preamble, harness contract, case-file path, observed-file path, and structured output schema.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial carried all discovered behavior in one context and wrote modules directly, avoiding child handoff interfaces.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced research handoffs but not final implementation interfaces; no retained context-label defect is separately proven.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: After launching the workflow, the parent only announced the start of implementation and did not create /output deliverable files before timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote many ESM library modules for Python JSON parsing, numeric operations, referencing, jsonschema exceptions, types, equality, and keyword handlers.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial achieved a partial implementation tree; parallel remained at probe harness/research and produced no copied artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Some probe children returned structured findings, but the workflow itself was killed with many agents still in progress and no aggregate implementation handoff.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to join; its local writes remained in the output tree until timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel accumulated unfinished child lifecycle state; serial's lifecycle problem was local incompletion rather than child-result management.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Shared probe directories were used by many children, but no final implementation files were integrated or copied into the artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote implementation modules under /output/lib and the artifact copier preserved that partial tree, but no entry point was present.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had no final tree to integrate; serial had a coherent partial library tree that still lacked assembly into test5.mjs.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel built probe tooling and produced some empirical corpora, but no whole-task Node implementation was verified before closure; official evaluation passed 0/166.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial repeatedly probed the Python executable and checked small module behavior, but did not run an integrated final CLI; official evaluation also passed 0/166.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Neither performed final acceptance verification; parallel verification effort was mostly delegated probing, while serial verification was local but unfinished.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel process timed out after 2399 seconds with 43 subagents, one workflow task, 480 child tool calls, and 2.28M workflow-child tokens.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial process also timed out after 2399 seconds, but had zero workflow tasks/subagents and spent the budget on 47 local LLM requests and 50 local tool calls.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both ran out of time, but parallel consumed much of its budget in fan-out and ended with no artifact, whereas serial converted time into a partial implementation tree.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both current completed official evaluations failed 0/166, so there is no discordant official outcome. The concrete task-solving difference is completion depth: parallel spent most of the run in an overbroad background probe workflow and produced no copied artifact files, while serial used a single-agent implementation path and left a partial /output/lib tree but still omitted the required test5.mjs entry point.
parallel_contributors: Broad 15-family probe workflow plus extension phase consumed child tokens/tool calls and left the parent without completed deliverables.
serial_contributors: Single-agent implementation wrote many library modules but ran out of time before the final entry file and integrated verification.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial's remaining failure is ordinary incomplete assembly of test5.mjs after building supporting modules.
Parallel's lack of deliverable files is tied to its coordination/budget strategy rather than a specific validator coding defect.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: No pass/fail differential; the retained pattern explains the parallel run's worse deliverable coverage within a both-fail pair.
